title: Oil Extends Gains as US Weighs Sending Carrier to Middle East
summary: Oil climbed for a third day as the US mulled sending another aircraft carrier group to the Middle East, potentially escalating the war with Iran and threatening to hamper a recovery in energy flows from the region.

title: Swelling Bets Against Treasuries Are Fueling Repo Borrowing Cost
summary: US funding markets could face disruptions from traders seeking to profit from a continued march higher in Treasury yields.
